title: SEARCH KEY PHRASE
body:
Notes is a big part of what I do on my phone.

I want to be able to search for text and phrase I recall, tap on the results and taken to exactly where it was written. I should also be able to have options of searching the traditional way or the way it currently does the searching (sometimes I type a phrase of just 2 words, and most results have those 2 words in different places in one note, and totally misses the point, and one ends up scrolling endlessly).

The highlight of the texts being searched for should also work every time.

If searching can be improved on, this would be one of the best apps on the iPhone.
